description: Unit test class for ImmutablePayload, testing its immutability, accessors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and builder.

classes.name: ImmutablePayloadTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutablePayload, verifying immutability, correctness of getters, serialization, and builder pattern.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static test data before any tests are run.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract of ImmutablePayload using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutablePayload and related classes are immutable using MutabilityAssert.

methods.name: gettersReturnExpected
methods.description: Tests that the getter methods of ImmutablePayload return expected values.

methods.name: toJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method serializes ImmutablePayload correctly.

methods.name: fromJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the fromJson method deserializes JSON into ImmutablePayload correctly.

methods.name: toBuilderMaintainsIdentity
methods.description: Checks that creating a new payload from an existing one via builder yields an identical object.
